name: NESTLE NAM. ADR/1 SF 1
summary: Nestle S.A. is a multinational food and beverage company headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland. It is the largest food company in the world measured by revenues, developing and marketing a wide range of products, including bottled water, chocolate, coffee, confectionery, dairy products, and pet food. This ticker represents an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) of Nestle shares.
